name: elbow flexion
description: Bending the elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder, working the front of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
